authority: Authored S6 shape arithmetic; project i owns files whose ordinal modulo project_count equals i, plus shared Source00000.cs; first (unit_count-project_count) projects select two native SDK TFMs.

source_formula.declared_project_references_per_unit: 0 for last project (leaf), 1 to leaf for all others
source_formula.call_targets: shared Source00000 Node.Value plus same-file Value, both compiled into every participating project
source_formula.preparation: One selected native SDK MSBuild solution Restore with static graph; distinct per-project obj/assets; command/status/time recorded outside measured product invocation

density_baseline.policy: capture_density(runtime, root) executes baseline and density-2x with exact authored declaration/collision checks and >=2x observed retained symbols/refs/call_edges checks. Explicit review_density_capture(capture, reviewer=..., review_reference=...) returns authority to persist here. Normal run_fixtures rejects absent review, provenance drift, baseline drift and retained density below 2x. This is retained syntax graph density, not compiler-selected semantic binding authority.
